parsedVerdict.reasoning: The Appointment entity sits in the business (domain) layer. Its behaviour (endsAt, overlaps, and the cancel rule with the two-hour cutoff) is domain logic and belongs there. However, the class is also annotated with TypeORM ORM decorators (@Entity() on the class and @Column() on the id field). That makes the domain entity a persistence mapping, which is an ORM/database concern that belongs to the persistence (infrastructure) layer. The domain file therefore also carries the persistence responsibility of declaring its table and column mapping. The typeorm import itself is a dependency-rule matter and out of scope, but the mapping declarations are a misplaced responsibility.
